name: Approval steps delay delivery
summary: Multiple sequential approvals are adding delay to routine work across operations, sales, and finance. Reports have risen steadily over the last six months.

relatedSignals.title: Approval steps delay routine deliveries
relatedSignals.summary: Routine dispatch requests wait on multiple sequential approvals, adding a day or more before goods leave the warehouse.

relatedSignals.title: Purchase-order approvals sit too long
relatedSignals.summary: Purchase orders wait on approvals with no visibility into who holds them up, delaying procurement.

name: System downtime interrupts daily work
summary: Outages and unstable access to core systems are interrupting work, with the sharpest impact on IT-dependent teams.

relatedSignals.title: Core system outage halts order entry
relatedSignals.summary: An unplanned outage of the order-management system stopped order entry for several hours with no clear status updates.

relatedSignals.title: Remote access is unstable during peak hours
relatedSignals.summary: Remote workers report frequent VPN drops during peak hours, interrupting work.

name: Cross-team handoffs lack clear ownership
summary: Work that crosses teams stalls when ownership is unclear at handoff. Volume has held steady over the period.

relatedSignals.title: Unclear escalation path for urgent cases
relatedSignals.summary: Support staff are unsure who owns urgent customer cases after hours, so escalations stall.

relatedSignals.title: Dispatch handoffs cause confusion
relatedSignals.summary: Handoffs between shifts lack a consistent checklist, so context and paperwork are sometimes lost.

relatedSignals.title: Cross-team ownership is unclear
relatedSignals.summary: Work that spans teams stalls because no single team clearly owns the outcome.

name: Manual re-entry between systems causes rework
summary: Disconnected systems force manual re-entry and reconciliation. Reports are trending down as early fixes land.

relatedSignals.title: Manual re-entry between finance systems
relatedSignals.summary: Invoice data is re-keyed by hand between two finance systems that do not sync, causing repeated rework.

relatedSignals.title: CRM data quality is inconsistent
relatedSignals.summary: Duplicate and incomplete CRM records make it hard to trust pipeline reports.

name: Onboarding buddy program well received
summary: A positive theme: the onboarding buddy program is drawing consistent praise from new hires and is worth scaling.

relatedSignals.title: Onboarding buddy program is working well
relatedSignals.summary: New hires say the onboarding buddy program helped them ramp up faster and feel supported.

name: Field teams lack adequate equipment
summary: Field and on-site teams report equipment gaps that slow their work. Volume is steady and concentrated in operations.

relatedSignals.title: Field teams lack adequate equipment
relatedSignals.summary: Field sales staff report outdated or missing equipment that slows customer visits.
